list.title: Tax Percentage Master
list.subtitle: Rule-based tax configuration. Click Settings on any row to configure — status and flags are managed there only.
list.tableSubtitle: Read-only view. Use Settings to change status, flags, or mode.

overview.title: Configuration Overview
overview.subtitle: Read-only snapshot of every tax's configuration, grouped by calculation mode.

drawer.saveFirstNotice: Save this tax on the General tab first.
drawer.configAvailableAfterSave: Configuration is available once the tax has been created.
drawer.savingHint: Saving will create the tax, then open its Configuration tab.
drawer.saveSettingsHint: Saves General and the current Configuration tab together.

unsavedChanges.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsavedChanges.description: You have unsaved changes on this tab. Leaving now will discard them.

statusInfo.active: Tax is active and will be applied during assessment calculations.
statusInfo.deactive: Tax is inactive and will not be applied during assessments.

assessmentInfo.active: Tax participates in property assessment calculations.
assessmentInfo.deactive: Tax does not participate in assessment calculations.

general.assessmentStatusLockedHint: Set Status to Active to change Assessment Status.

modeChange.title: Change Rule Category?
modeChange.description: Switching from {from} to {to} permanently deletes this tax's existing configuration: {discarded}. You will need to configure the new rule category from scratch. This cannot be undone.

oldTaxInfo.active: This is a legacy tax entry used for historical records.
oldTaxInfo.deactive: Not a legacy entry — standard tax record.

condition.title: Condition Rule
condition.orderMattersHint: Rules are checked top to bottom — every row whose conditions match contributes to the result, and their amounts are added together. Turn on "Stop Further Processing" on a row to skip every row below it once that row matches. Use the ↑/↓ arrows to reorder.
condition.stopFurtherProcessingHint: If this row matches, evaluation stops here — rows below it are skipped. Leave off to let every matching row add to the total.
condition.noRowsYet: No condition rules yet. Click "Add Condition Rule" to define one.
condition.rangeToInvalid: "To" value must be greater than or equal to "From" value
condition.noConditionsYet: No conditions yet — this row always matches.
condition.deleteRowDescription: This permanently deletes this condition rule immediately.
condition.scopeNotConfigured: Condition fields haven't been configured yet for the Dynamic Tax Register. Ask an admin to set up the "DynamicTaxRegisterCondition" Rule Scope and its fields before adding condition rules.
condition.multiplyByHint: The result is {value} × this field's value for the property.
condition.multiplyByNoNumericHint: No fields are marked numeric, so all fields are listed. Pick one that holds a count — a non-numeric value evaluates to zero.

testPanel.title: Test this Rule
testPanel.cascadeHint: Pick a property by Zone → Ward → Property → Partition to test the saved configuration against it (Finance Year optional).
testPanel.noRowMatched: No row matched — this property doesn't satisfy any active condition row.
testPanel.sampleValuesHint: Tests the saved configuration against a real property — enter its Property Id (and optionally a specific Property Details Id / Finance Year).
testPanel.noRowsToTest: Add at least one condition rule before testing.
testPanel.enterPropertyId: Enter a valid Property Id first
testPanel.unitCountUnresolved: This property has no value recorded for {field}, so the amount is 0. The rule matched — only the count is missing.
testPanel.referenceTaxAmountUnresolved: {tax} has no recorded result for this property yet, so the amount is 0. The rule matched — only the referenced tax's result is missing.

condition.floorWiseOptionDesc: Evaluates conditions floor by floor using each floor's total area and values.
condition.allFloorsAggregatedOptionDesc: Aggregates all floors together using the property's total area and values across all floors.

manageRule.title: Manage Rule Category
manageRule.subtitle: Admin — define rules available to end users
manageRule.infoBanner: Rules defined here appear in the Rule Name dropdown on the configuration screen. Users see only the Display Name — internal types and table names stay hidden.
manageRule.conditionConfiguredPerTaxHint: Conditions for this rule are configured per-tax, on the tax's own Configuration tab (Condition tab) after this rule is selected as its Rule Name.
manageRule.ruleInUseHint: In use by a tax — can't be deleted or deactivated.
manageRule.ruleTypeLockedHint: In use by a tax — Rule Category can't be changed.
manageRule.deleteDescription: This will permanently remove the rule from the register.
